# dsh-composer-suggest
Composer suggestions for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

- **Next message**: after the agent replies, the empty composer shows the message you
are most likel

y to send next.
- **Draft continuation**: with text in the composer and the caret at its end, press

**Tab**. The composer shows "Continuing…" with a spinner while the model works from
the conversation

above and your draft; press **Tab** again to accept the result, or
**Esc** to cancel. Nothing is as

ked until you press Tab, and Tab keeps its usual job
anywhere else (empty composer, caret mid-draft,

a `/` command or `@` reference).
- **Tab** accepts a suggestion as an editable draft (nothing is se

nt),
**Alt+Down / Alt+Up** cycle up to three candidates, **Esc** withdraws the offer, and
typing dis

cards it.
- A suggestion longer than what is left of the line wraps in place, at the same column
the

accepted text would, and the toolbar row below is pushed down to make room.
To do that the plugin s

ets a temporary bottom margin on the composer's scroll element
(the one marked `data-input-scroll`)

and removes it when the suggestion goes away. If
a Harness update renames that element, the suggesti

on still shows but may cover the
toolbar until the selector in `client.js` is updated.
- **Settings

→ General** has one switch per mode, and a status line that shows which
model route answered last, h
ow long it took, or why a request failed.

Every suggestion is one model call and uses tokens. It is not written to the Session
log and does no
t show in the token meter.

Restart the Harness afterwards, then refresh the Web page. Developed and tested against

ness 0.2.2-rc.1. It needs a Harness that provides `conversation.input.overlay`,
`settings.general.it
em`, `connection.admit()`, `ctx.llm` and `session.deriveMessages()`.
## Model

By default a suggestion is answered by the model the Session already uses, at that
model's lowest re
asoning effort, with no temperature set.

To use another model, type its id (for example `claude-sonnet-5-5`) in
**Settings → General → Model

for suggestions** and press Enter. Leave it empty to follow
the Session again. It is saved in the br

owser you typed it in, and the status line under
it reports which route answered last or why a reque

typed it in, and the status line under
it reports which route answered last or why a request failed.

To set the model for every browser instead, override the row in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. A

ny option you leave out keeps its default, and a model typed in
Settings wins over this:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Without a `provider`, the model is looked up among the providers mounted in your
profile, trying the

Session's provider first. If none offers it, the request fails with
`model-unavailable` instead of

silently using another model. Set `provider` and `model`
together in the configuration to name the r

oute exactly. See `cordis.patch.yml` for every
option.
## Credits and licenses

This plugin is a combination of ideas and code from two MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness
plugins. Their

license texts are kept in this repository, and
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists what comes from where.
| Project | Author | License | Used here |
| dsh-composer-predictions | Stijnus | MIT, LICENSE.stijnus | Code adapted: the streaming Host endpo
int and owner check, prompt construction, candidate normalization, caret measurement, ghost position

ing, SSE parsing and the keyboard handling. |
| dsh-composer-prediction | Amir Bazylkhanov | MIT, LI
CENSE.bazylkhanov | Behaviour reimplemented from its documentation and source: withdrawing a dismiss
ed offer for the rest of the turn, IME handling, reporting a failed request in Settings, and using t
he model's cheapest advertised reasoning effort. |

What this project adds: continuation is triggered by Tab instead of running on every
typing pause, a

visible "Continuing…" state with cancel, separate switches for the two
modes, a model setting that

follows the Session or names a model, a status line in
Settings, and short on-screen notices for emp
ty or failed continuations.

This project is released under the MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 WuweiRE, see
LICENSE. It is not a
ffiliated with DeepSeek or with the authors above.
